title: Save As Dialog
description: Write text to a file chosen by the user in the OS save dialog.
signature: export const saveAs = (name: string, text: string) => invoke<SavedAs | null>('files/save-as', { name, text }, 3600000)
returns: Promise<SavedAs | null> with path and mtime, or null if cancelled
semantics: Shows OS save dialog; returns null if user cancels.
